run_dots_and_boxes_game: run the dots_and_boxes game with two random agents using the default 2x2 board configuration
run_human_vs_random_game: run the dots_and_boxes game with a human player against a random agent on a 2x2 board
load_agent_by_type: load a uniform random or human bot agent for a specified player id with a given random seed
run_game_with_custom_seed: run the dots_and_boxes game with a custom random seed for reproducible gameplay
run_game_and_print_utilities: run the dots_and_boxes game and print the final utility scores for each player
